{{Quote|The m'iiyoom is a white flower that blossoms in the season of trine, a season when all three moons give their light. It's also called the ''nightlily''.|M'iiyoom Onith|audio=Miiyoom-Nightlily.flac|<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
A '''m'iiyoom''', also called a '''nightlily''', was a carnivorous [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that fed on small [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] and [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that tried to drink the [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] from its white blossoms. It bloomed only during the season of [[trine]], when all three moons of [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]] reflected light from the system's [[Star/Legends|sun]].

[[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]], a [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], was named after this flower.
